verses.1: A prayer for David, who serves the LORD. May the children of El may also serve the LORD with honor and glory.
verses.2: Hallow the name of the LORD with great honor. Worship the LORD in holiness.
verses.3: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters; it brings destruction upon those who are evil. The LORD has brought great destruction upon many waters.
verses.4: The voice of Jehovah in power. The voice of Jehovah from heaven.
verses.5: The voice of the LORD shatters thorns; and the LORD shall shatter the thorns of the Lavan.
verses.6: And they were like wheels made of gold, and like cherubsim.
verses.7: The voice of Jehovah shouts to the flames.
verses.8: The voice of the LORD will be heard from the desert. The LORD will speak from the Holy Land.
verses.9: The voice of the LORD will bring destruction upon the wicked. It will destroy forests and ruin their homes. In their dwellings, they will say, “Woe!”
verses.10: The Lord will reign forever; the Lord will sit as king for ever.
verses.11: YHWH will be strong for His people. YHWH will bless His people in peace.
